Clarification questions

Planning can't finish yet. The issue says the spec `docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md` overrides it on names, endpoint paths, JSON keys, storage design and the file list. That spec can't be read from here. A plan built on guessed names could clash with Phases 2 and 4, so I'm asking the questions below instead.

**Planning ref:** `git rev-parse HEAD` = `f9d5c7a3fdaeb0b57a4665c99dd96d1289a072c2`, symbolic branch `orchestrator/project-8969`, integration branch mismatch `false`.

**Where I looked for the spec:**
- It is not in the working tree.
- It is not in the default-branch snapshot (`isolated-base`); `docs/plans/` there has no ChatGPT plan.
- It does not appear in any file in the checkout.
- Fetching `origin/claude/intelligent-meitner-xdlkhd` is not allowed in this sandbox, which has no remote and no network.
- A web search for the plan and for PR #8966 found nothing.

**What the code at HEAD shows, and why these choices can't be guessed:**
- **Routing:** `tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts` serves only `POST /v1/pool`. Line 512 returns 404 for any other path.
- **No storage:** `Env` (line 41) has only `CLAUDE_POOL_TOKENS`, `PROBE_MODEL`, `GATE` and `BROKER_GITHUB_READ_TOKEN`. `tools/claude-pool-broker/wrangler.toml` has no KV, Durable Object or D1 binding. Today the broker can only read credentials, and the issue asks for "read and write paths, refresh-token handling". That needs a storage design the plan defines.
- **Refresh-token risk:** ChatGPT-account credentials carry a refresh token that is replaced each time it is used. If two jobs refresh at once, or a runner refreshes on its own, the broker's stored copy stops working. Storage and response shape are therefore safety decisions, not naming details.
- **Allowlist:** `authorize()` (lines 456–508) checks `job_workflow_ref` against `ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES` (line 73). `tests/test_claude_pool_token.py` keeps that list equal to the set of workflows that use `claude-pool-token`. The issue says a new endpoint needs its own list "unless the plan says it reuses this one", so the answer is in the plan.
- **No config to copy:** there is no `.github/ai/*pool*.json` at HEAD. The keys for `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` come only from the plan.
- **Size:** the issue lists 13 files besides the advisory tests. That is above the planning prompt's 10-file "scope-too-large" signal. I'm noting it, not blocking on it.

Clarification is required before planning.

> **Q1: How should planning get the authoritative Phase 1 spec, which is not on the planning ref?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — Commit `docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md` (from PR #8966) onto `orchestrator/project-8969`, or paste its Phase 1 section into the issue body word for word, then re-run planning from it. The plan's names, paths, keys and storage design win. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — Plan from the issue text plus the answers to Q2–Q6, accepting that names may differ from what Phases 2 and 4 expect.
> - **C** — Hold this sub-issue until PR #8966 merges to main and the integration branch picks it up.
>
> Reply: `Q1: A`

> **Q2: Where does the broker keep the ChatGPT credential, given that its refresh token is replaced on every use?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — A Durable Object binding (class, binding and migration declared in `wrangler.toml`). It serialises refreshes so two jobs can't use the same refresh token at once. It needs no namespace ID from outside the repo. It is seeded once from a Wrangler secret (for example `CHATGPT_POOL_SEED`) and the rotated token is written back to the object. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — A Workers KV namespace binding with the same seed-then-persist flow. This needs a KV namespace ID that does not exist yet, and KV updates are not immediately consistent, so two refreshes at once can break the stored credential.
> - **C** — A read-only Wrangler secret written only from `shubhodeep1/claude-workers`, the way `CLAUDE_POOL_TOKENS` is, with no refresh in the broker. Refresh happens outside the broker, and changes to that repo are out of scope for this issue.
>
> Reply: `Q2: A`

> **Q3: What are the endpoint path and the write path?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — `POST /v1/chatgpt` returns a credential to an OIDC-verified job. There is no HTTP write endpoint: seeding comes from the Wrangler secret, and only the broker writes the rotated token into storage. `/v1/pool` is unchanged. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — `POST /v1/chatgpt` for reads plus `PUT /v1/chatgpt/credential` for operator writes, behind a separate admin secret.
> - **C** — Other paths named in the spec (give them in the answer).
>
> Reply: `Q3: A`

> **Q4: What does the endpoint return to the runner?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — Access token, ID token, `account_id` and expiry only, never the refresh token, so a runner can't rotate it and break the broker's copy. The action writes a 0600 `auth.json` under `$RUNNER_TEMP` from these fields. Whether the Codex CLI accepts an `auth.json` without a refresh token has not been checked. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — The full credential including the refresh token. The runner may rotate it, and the broker's stored copy then stops working.
> - **C** — The shape defined in the spec (give the JSON keys in the answer).
>
> Reply: `Q4: A`

> **Q5: Which workflow allowlist protects the new endpoint?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — A new `CHATGPT_ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES`, empty in Phase 1, so every call is refused with `403 workflow_not_allowed` until Phase 2 wires a workflow in. A contract test keeps it equal to the set of `.github/workflows/*.yml` that use `.github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token`, which is empty for now. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — A new list pre-filled with `review_autofix.yml`, ahead of Phase 2.
> - **C** — Reuse the existing `ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES`.
>
> Reply: `Q5: A`

> **Q6: Which OIDC audience and `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` keys should be used?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — A separate audience, `coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool`, so a token issued for one endpoint can't be replayed against the other. Config keys: `schema_version: 1`, `broker_url`, `audience`, `reviewer_slot_enabled: false`. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — Reuse the audience `coding-workflows-claude-pool`, with the same config keys.
> - **C** — The audience and keys named in the spec (give them in the answer).
>
> Reply: `Q6: A`

Answering `Q1: A` only helps if the spec file is actually committed to `orchestrator/project-8969` or pasted into the issue before planning re-runs. Otherwise the next run stops at the same gap. If the spec can't be supplied, answer `Q1: B` together with Q2–Q6, and the next run will plan from those answers.
